person.invited: Invited by email, votes once they join
person.invitedFinished: Invited by email. Votes once they have joined and this is reopened
person.invitedToLook: Invited by email, sees it once they join
person.toInvite: Gets an invitation when you save
person.toInviteAtStart: Gets an invitation when you start

count.newPapers: {count, plural, one {# new paper} other {# new papers}}
count.openPapers: {count, plural, one {# open paper} other {# open papers}}

pdf.costsMore: more for one read as its PDF

removed.unread: Could not be read or found

excludeAsk.must: {many, select, true {Which must-have do these papers fail?} other {Which must-have does it fail?}}
excludeAsk.criterion: {many, select, true {Which criterion do these papers fail?} other {Which criterion does it fail?}}
excludeAsk.why: {many, select, true {Why exclude them?} other {Why exclude it?}}

living: {every, select, day {Every day} week {Every week} other {Every month}}

means.all: A paper is settled once every reviewer given it has voted and all of them voted the same way. Any split is a conflict.
means.most: A paper is settled once every reviewer given it has voted and more than half of them voted the same way. With no such majority it is a conflict.
means.one: A paper is settled by the first vote on it, so there is never a conflict. Where a person is given the paper, the first person's vote settles it. A model's vote settles only a paper no person has.

started: {papers, plural, one {# paper} other {# papers}} from {sources, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}, for {who}

empty.include: {finished, select, true {No paper was included} other {Nothing included yet}}
empty.maybe: {finished, select, true {No paper was left at Maybe} other {Nothing marked Maybe yet}}
empty.exclude: {finished, select, true {No paper was excluded} other {Nothing excluded yet}}
empty.waiting: No papers waiting for a vote

hiddenWhileToDo: Hidden while papers wait for your vote
votesHiddenSays: This screening hides other votes from a reviewer only on papers that still wait for that reviewer's own vote.
